paragraphs: QQQ is +0.14% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -16/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -8 → now -16; open +1 → now -16 (deteriorated 17 points).

Breadth are a headwind: Live · Nasdaq-100 breadth: 34/101 advancing (34%) · 67 declining · 0 flat. It changed from mixed to negative after the baseline snapshot. Semiconductors are supportive: Live · SOX +1.19% | Nasdaq -0.08% | SOX vs Nasdaq +1.27 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +1.57 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +1.45 pp.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps negative, breadth negative).
